contracts.declared_mechanism: Pre-execution guard inside ask_database: (1) case-insensitive SELECT-prefix check on the stripped query with early error return (backend/app.py:351-353), and (2) forbidden-keyword substring blocklist with early error return (backend/app.py:355-358), both applied to sql_query after LLM generation and code-fence/quote stripping (lines 341-348) and before db.run(sql_query).

contracts.protected_operation: Execution of LLM-generated SQL against the appointments database via db.run() inside the ask_database tool, which answers agent-relayed questions about appointments, patients, and schedules.

contracts.protection_obligation: Within the ask_database tool, only read-only SELECT statements generated by the LLM may be executed against the Postgres appointments database via SQLDatabase.run; any LLM-generated SQL that is not a SELECT or that contains mutating/DDL keywords (insert, update, delete, drop, alter, create, truncate) must be rejected before the execution commit point.
